title: Restriction of an etale relation preserves its quotient
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U$ be a scheme over $S$, and let $(s,t):R\to U\times_SU$ [def-pc-fibre-product] be an etale equivalence relation: $R(T)$ is an equivalence relation on $U(T)$ for every $S$-scheme $T$, and $s,t$ are etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $g:U'\to U$ be any etale morphism, and set $R'=U'\times_{g,U,s}R\times_{t,U,g}U'$ with its induced two maps to $U'$. Then $R'\to U'\times_SU'$ is an etale equivalence relation, and the canonical map from the sheaf quotient of $U'$ by $R'$ to the sheaf quotient $F$ of $U$ by $R$ on $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site, def-weil-pbc-sheafification] is injective; if $g$ is surjective, this canonical map is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 02WT and 045Z (pullback/restriction of a pre-equivalence relation), together with the surjective-cover clause of Tag 045Z.

proof.text: By [def-pc-fibre-product], for every $S$-scheme $T$ a $T$-point of $R'$ is a triple $(a,r,b)$ with $a,b\in U'(T)$, $r\in R(T)$, $s(r)=g(a)$ and $t(r)=g(b)$. Thus the induced relation on $U'(T)$ is $a\sim' b$ if and only if $g(a)\sim g(b)$. Reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity follow respectively from these three properties of the relation on $U(T)$. Since $R(T)$ is an equivalence relation, its arrow with specified endpoints is unique, so the triple is determined by $(a,b)$; this also verifies the monomorphism into $U'\times_SU'$. These identifications are natural in $T$, giving the required equivalence relation over $S$.

For the first projection put $A=U'\times_{g,U,s}R$, with maps $p:A\to U'$ and $v=t\circ\operatorname{pr}_R:A\to U$. Then $R'=A\times_{v,U,g}U'$, and $s':R'\to U'$ factors as $R'\to A\xrightarrow{p}U'$. The first map is a base change of $g$, and the second is a base change of $s$. Both are etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change], so their composite is etale by clause (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. For $t'$ use $B=R\times_{t,U,g}U'$: the map $R'\to B$ is a base change of $g$ along $s\circ\operatorname{pr}_R$, and $B\to U'$ is a base change of $t$. The same two cited statements make $t'$ etale. Together with Step 1 this proves that $R'$ is an etale equivalence relation.

source.place: Tag 02WT (lemma-pullback-etale-equivalence-relation), proof: composition of base changes of etale morphisms.

proof.text: Write $P(T)=U(T)/R(T)$ and $P'(T)=U'(T)/R'(T)$ for the presheaf quotients. The formula $[a]\mapsto[g\circ a]$ gives a natural map $v:P'\to P$ by the relation calculation in Step 1. Moreover it is injective on each $T$: if $[g\circ a]=[g\circ b]$, some $r:T\to R$ has endpoints $g\circ a,g\circ b$, so $(a,r,b):T\to R'$ witnesses $[a]=[b]$. Let $F'=P'^\#$ and $F=P^\#$. The universal property in [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] applied to $P'\xrightarrow{v}P\to F$ gives the canonical map $\alpha:F'\to F$, with $\alpha(\eta'[a])=\eta[g\circ a]$ for the sheafification units $\eta',\eta$.

source.place: Tag 045Z, relation calculation and canonical quotient map; Tag 02VG (definition-quotient-sheaf).

proof.text: To prove injectivity fix $\xi,\zeta\in F'(T)$ with $\alpha(\xi)=\alpha(\zeta)$. The local-representative assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local], applied to $P'$, gives coverings representing each section by a quotient class. Pull back one covering along the other and compose, using the site axioms of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], to obtain a common covering $T_i\to T$ and representatives $a_i,b_i:T_i\to U'$ for $\xi|_{T_i},\zeta|_{T_i}$. Their images give classes $[g a_i],[g b_i]\in P(T_i)$ with equal images in $F(T_i)$. The local-equality assertion of [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local], now applied to $P$, gives a further covering of each $T_i$ where these classes agree. Step 3's injectivity of $v$ then gives $[a_i]=[b_i]$ on that refinement. Hence $\xi$ and $\zeta$ agree on a covering of $T$, and the sheaf equalizer condition of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] gives $\xi=\zeta$. This proves sectionwise injectivity of $\alpha$ for every $T$.

source.place: Tag 045Z, injectivity proof; local representatives and local equality supplied by Sites Tags 00WB and 00WK.

proof.text: Suppose now that $g$ is surjective. By [def-weil-etale-morphism], $g$ is flat and locally of finite presentation, so $\{g\}$ is an fppf covering by [def-pc-fppf-site]. For $z\in F(T)$, [lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local] applied to $P$ supplies an fppf covering $T_i\to T$ where $z$ is represented by a map $a_i:T_i\to U$. Pull back the singleton etale surjective family $\{g\}$ along $a_i$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change], the projection $W_i=T_i\times_{a_i,U,g}U'\to T_i$ is etale and surjective, hence again an fppf covering by the same two definitions. Its second projection $b_i:W_i\to U'$ satisfies $g b_i=a_i\operatorname{pr}_{T_i}$, so $\eta'[b_i]\in F'(W_i)$ maps to $z|_{W_i}$. The site composition axiom of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] makes $\{W_i\to T\}$ a covering. Thus every section of $F$ lifts locally through $\alpha$.

source.place: Tag 045Z, surjective-cover clause; explicit pullback lifting of a representative, also the covering clause of Tag 02VH.

proof.text: For the local lifts from Step 5, their two restrictions to each overlap have the same $\alpha$-image, namely the restriction of $z$. Step 4, applied to that overlap, makes the restrictions equal. The sheaf equalizer condition of [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] therefore glues the lifts uniquely to $\widetilde z\in F'(T)$, and separation of $F$ gives $\alpha(\widetilde z)=z$. Step 4 gives uniqueness of this preimage. Restricting $\widetilde z$ along any test-scheme morphism gives the unique preimage of the restricted $z$, so these inverses are natural in $T$. They define an inverse of $\alpha$, proving the asserted isomorphism when $g$ is surjective.

source.place: Tag 045Z, final isomorphism conclusion, with the sheaf gluing argument written out.

lean.statement: theorem etale_relation_restriction_quotient {S : Scheme.{u}} {R U U' : Over S} (s t : R ⟶ U) [Mono (prod.lift s t)] (hrel : ∀ T : Over S, Equivalence (fun a b : T ⟶ U ↦ ∃ r : T ⟶ R, r ≫ s = a ∧ r ≫ t = b)) (g : U' ⟶ U) [Etale s.left] [Etale t.left] [Etale g.left] (F : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (η : coequalizer (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ⟶ F.obj) (hη : ∀ G : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u), Function.Bijective (fun k : F.obj ⟶ G.obj ↦ η ≫ k)) (F' : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (η' : coequalizer (yoneda.map (restrictedEtaleRelationSource s t g)) (yoneda.map (restrictedEtaleRelationTarget s t g)) ⟶ F'.obj) (hη' : ∀ G : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u), Function.Bijective (fun k : F'.obj ⟶ G.obj ↦ η' ≫ k)) : Mono (prod.lift (restrictedEtaleRelationSource s t g) (restrictedEtaleRelationTarget s t g)) ∧ (∀ T : Over S, Equivalence (fun a b : T ⟶ U' ↦ ∃ r : T ⟶ restrictedEtaleRelation s t g, r ≫ restrictedEtaleRelationSource s t g = a ∧ r ≫ restrictedEtaleRelationTarget s t g = b)) ∧ Etale (restrictedEtaleRelationSource s t g).left ∧ Etale (restrictedEtaleRelationTarget s t g).left ∧ ∃ α : F'.obj ⟶ F.obj, (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map (restrictedEtaleRelationSource s t g)) (yoneda.map (restrictedEtaleRelationTarget s t g)) ≫ η') ≫ α = yoneda.map g ≫ (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ≫ η) ∧ Mono α ∧ (Surjective g.left → IsIso α)
lean.note: The restricted relation and its projections are the actual iterated pullbacks in Over S. The two sheaf quotients are specified by their sheafification universal properties at the presheaf coequalizers, following the existing EtaleRelationQuotient interface. The quotient-projection compatibility uniquely determines the canonical map alpha; Mono alpha is equivalent to injectivity on every test scheme. No global sheafification-existence assumption is imposed on the big site.
